footnote_text: This Form 4/A is filed to correct a broker error. On October 30, 2026, the broker inadvertently executed unauthorized sales of 2,055 shares of Class A Common Stock during a restricted period defined under the Reporting Person's Rule 10b5-1 trading plan.  These unauthorized sales were reported on the Form 4 filed on November 3, 2026. The broker subsequently unwound these sales and restored the shares to the Reporting Person's account. || Certain of these securities are restricted stock units. Each restricted stock unit represents the Reporting Person's right to receive one share of Class A Common Stock, subject to the applicable vesting schedule through February 15, 2030. In the event the Reporting Person ceases to be a Service Provider, the unvested restricted stock units will be cancelled by the Issuer.
